art_direction: 无一郎穿宽松蓝色便服走过云雾山间长廊。
composition_variation: Depict Muichiro Tokito walking gently through a pale mountain walkway above a low blanket of mist. Dress him in an age-appropriate fully covering loose blue-gray tunic and trousers, with his long dark hair fading turquoise at the ends. One hand brushes a wooden railing. Use minimal atmospheric watercolor, silver light, restrained turquoise details, and a dreamy calm expression. Keep the entire setting reassuring. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
